title: Finding 59:29 in the Monster
summary: The classification of the maximal subgroups of the Monster group has been completed recently, and explicit generators for each such subgroup (up to conjugacy) have been made available for the software mmgroup, with the exception of the maximal subgroup 59:29, see Dietrich et al. (Adv. Math., 2025; J Algebra, 2026). We provide explicit generators for this last maximal subgroup and comment on the extensive search that led to finding them. Our method is similar to, but significantly more involved than Bray et al.'s (London Math. Soc. J. Comput. Math., 2016) approach for constructing 47:23 in…
